import uuid

from django.db import models
from django.utils import timezone


class PostStatus(models.TextChoices):
    DRAFT = "draft", "Draft"
    PUBLISHED = "published", "Published"


class BlogUser(models.Model):
    id = models.AutoField(primary_key=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "blog_user"


class BlogCategory(models.Model):
    id = models.AutoField(primary_key=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField()
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100, unique=True)
    slug = models.CharField(max_length=50)
    parent = models.ForeignKey("BlogCategory", on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name="blog_categories")

    class Meta:
        db_table = "blog_category"


class BlogTag(models.Model):
    id = models.AutoField(primary_key=True)
    label = models.CharField(max_length=50)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "blog_tag"


class BlogPost(models.Model):
    id = models.AutoField(primary_key=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField()
    public_id = models.UUIDField(unique=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    body = models.TextField()
    status = models.CharField(max_length=32, choices=PostStatus.choices, default=PostStatus.DRAFT)
    rating = models.DecimalField(max_digits=4, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True)
    view_count = models.IntegerField(default=0)
    is_featured = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    published_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    metadata = models.JSONField(default=dict)
    author = models.ForeignKey("BlogUser", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="author_blog_posts")
    editor = models.ForeignKey("BlogUser", on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name="editor_blog_posts")
    category = models.ForeignKey("BlogCategory", on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="blog_posts")
    tags = models.ManyToManyField("BlogTag", related_name="blog_posts", blank=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "blog_post"
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(fields=["author", "title"], name="blog_post_author_id_title_key"),
        ]
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["title"], name="blog_post_title_idx"),
            models.Index(fields=["published_at", "status"], name="post_pub_status_idx"),
        ]


class BlogProfile(models.Model):
    id = models.AutoField(primary_key=True)
    bio = models.TextField(null=True, blank=True)
    avatar = models.CharField(max_length=100, null=True, blank=True)
    user = models.OneToOneField("BlogUser", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="blog_profile")

    class Meta:
        db_table = "blog_profile"
